Governance, Finance & Compliance Coordination

Coordinated support so your governance, finance and compliance foundations are sound as you operate in Saudi Arabia.

Book a Consultation

Service overview

A clear line of sight on obligations

We coordinate with your legal, tax and accounting advisers and the relevant authorities, helping you understand obligations, calendars and controls, without replacing your regulated professional advisers.

Who it is for

Is this service right for you?

  • Newly established Saudi entities building their control environment
  • Finance and legal teams coordinating across several advisers
  • Boards seeking clarity on governance responsibilities
  • Groups aligning local reporting with global standards

Common client challenges

Challenges we help you overcome

  • Keeping track of filing, reporting and renewal calendars
  • Aligning group policies with local requirements
  • Coordinating several external advisers and authorities
  • Designing proportionate governance for a new entity

Our scope

End-to-end support across your journey

Coordination and structure, working alongside your professional advisers.

  • Governance framework and delegation of authority
  • Compliance calendar and obligations register
  • Finance and reporting set-up coordination
  • Policy alignment with group standards
  • Coordination with legal, tax and audit advisers
  • Risk register and control outline

Key deliverables

What you will receive

  • Governance framework outline

  • Compliance and filing calendar

  • Obligations register

  • Policy alignment summary

  • Adviser coordination plan

Our process

A structured path to delivery

  1. 1

    Map

    We map obligations, advisers and decision rights.

  2. 2

    Design

    We outline a proportionate framework and calendar.

  3. 3

    Coordinate

    We coordinate inputs across advisers and authorities.

  4. 4

    Embed

    We help your team run the framework day to day.

Your responsibilities

How you can support

  • Provide required information and documentation

  • Timely review and approval of submissions

  • Engage in key meetings with relevant stakeholders

  • Share business objectives and operational plans

Frequently asked questions

FAQs

Are you a law, tax or audit firm?

No. We coordinate and structure the work, and you rely on your own licensed legal, tax and audit advisers for professional advice.

Can you introduce us to advisers?

Yes, where helpful we can introduce qualified firms, and you choose whom to appoint.

Do you support board reporting?

We can help structure the information boards need on governance and compliance.
